fix_instructions: C3 (linked to PF2): The check requires the reserve slot to be unfilled or vacant as a consequence of CPL Morris's 24-hour restriction. Two of three settled rollouts failed this by assigning reserve_person to "PFC Cole" (rollout 1) or "CPL Morris" (rollout 3) instead of "UNFILLED" or equivalent. This is an ENCODING MISMATCH — the model does not consistently infer that with only 3 available personnel and 3 shift slots, no one remains for reserve. Strengthen the shared_context or scenario setup to explicitly state that the reserve slot is distinct from the three shift slots and that the same person cannot serve both a shift and the reserve simultaneously, so the model cannot double-assign PFC Cole. Also ensure C3's wording explicitly validates that reserve_person is set to UNFILLED, VACANT, or an equivalent vacant marker rather than any personnel name. C5 (linked to PF2 and PF3): C5 passed in rollouts 2 and 3 but failed in rollout 1. In rollout 1 the settlement included only qualification_constraint, medical_restriction, and tasking_directive commitments but no escalation or shortfall follow-up — the model filled reserve_person with PFC Cole and thus saw no shortfall. This is downstream of the C3 encoding mismatch; fixing C3's reserve-encoding issue should resolve C5 as well, since correctly marking reserve as UNFILLED should prompt the shortfall follow-up commitment. P1 (linked to PF3): P1 passed in all three settled rollouts (1, 2, 3) and is not a failing check; no action needed. Rollout 0 turn-cap failure: A1 produced an unparsable JSON at turn 12 (malformed say action with stray quotation marks), which blocked settlement. This appears to be a transient generation error rather than a structural pacing problem — the conversation had reached consensus by turn 8 and could have settled at turn 9. Consider adding a settle-eligibility nudge in shared_context encouraging the commander to settle promptly once all subordinates have confirmed alignment, rather than continuing conversational turns after consensus.
